candidate_program.name: cheap_gap_aware_regret
candidate_program.rationale: Uses strongest-neighbor regret for tiny neighborhoods and a smoother crowding penalty otherwise, scaled by actual gap-to-duration cost. It adds no features but remains blind to remote interactions.
candidate_program.rule: (weight - max_conflict_weight if degree <= 1 else weight / (1 + 0.25 * degree) - 0.25 * conflict_weight / (1 + degree)) / (1 + (station_gap + satellite_gap) / (1 + duration))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
